name: xUnit & Integration Testing
description: xUnit & Integration Testing standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-DOTNET-TEST applies.

rules.title: Use unit tests for pure domain/application behavior
rules.detail: Prefer fast deterministic tests without host/database when verifying business logic that does not require infrastructure.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use unit tests for pure domain/application behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use unit tests for pure domain/application behavior.

rules.title: Use integration tests for API, EF and middleware contracts
rules.detail: Exercise the real DI container and realistic database/provider for persistence, auth, serialization and transaction behavior.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use integration tests for API, EF and middleware contracts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use integration tests for API, EF and middleware contracts.

rules.title: Keep test data isolated and repeatable
rules.detail: Each test owns or resets its data and does not depend on execution order or developer machine state.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep test data isolated and repeatable.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep test data isolated and repeatable.

rules.title: Test cancellation, validation and failure mapping for important endpoints
rules.detail: Do not test only HTTP 200 happy paths; verify representative error/status contracts.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test cancellation, validation and failure mapping for important endpoints.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test cancellation, validation and failure mapping for important endpoints.

rules.title: Use deterministic clocks/IDs/external fakes through abstractions
rules.detail: Control time and remote side effects where determinism matters while avoiding mocks of implementation details.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use deterministic clocks/IDs/external fakes through abstractions.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use deterministic clocks/IDs/external fakes through abstractions.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-DOTNET-TEST applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of xUnit & Integration Testing to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: xUnit & Integration Testing is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses xUnit & Integration Testing failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
